content.headline: Before you trust an image — ask: is this real?
content.body: AI can produce documentary-looking photographs from a two-line prompt in seconds. That is useful for first-draft campaign visuals — and it is exactly why verification habits matter.
bullets: Hook: would you believe this was a real photograph?
Demo: flood-relief / infrastructure staging scene (no real official faces)
Open Gemini, Midjourney, or ChatGPT Images — humans still approve before publish
